mechanics.claim: Ambessa heals herself for a percentage of the post-mitigation damage she deals to enemies with her active abilities.
mechanics.quote: '''Ambessa''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}} and {{tip|heals}} herself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} she deals to enemies with her active abilities.

mechanics.claim: The healing effectiveness is reduced to 25% of its normal value against minions and monsters (not relevant against a champion-type dummy target).
mechanics.quote: The healing effectiveness is reduced to 25% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: The armor penetration passive is a persistent self-buff, not tied to casting R, and applies to all of Ambessa's damage.
The damage and stun only apply if Ambessa successfully seizes and suppresses the target; if suppression is not applied or is removed early, damage and stun fail to apply.
mechanics.quote: She will be unable to apply the damage and stun in this case since the suppression was not applied in the first place.

mechanics.claim: The damage lands after the target is picked up and crashed back down, following the suppression duration, not immediately on cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Ambessa''' picks them up off the ground before crashing them back down, afterwards dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.4}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Ambessa is unable to act during the cast time and while the target is suppressed.
mechanics.quote: '''''Ambessa''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the cast time and while the target is suppressed.
